basic_info.description: Experience the vibrant South Beach lifestyle in this charming contemporary 1BR + Den condo at the coveted 170 Off Third complex. It features a spacious, light-filled open floor plan seamlessly integrating the bright & elegant living/dining space & modern kitchen, creating the perfect venue for entertaining. Living room boasts large floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the lush, manicured courtyard & resort style pool. Modern kitchen features center island, stainless steel appliances, granite countertops & custom cabinetry. A tranquil retreat, the bedroom overlooks the lush courtyard & offers a walk-in closet w/ organizers & adjoining bathroom. Versatile den space is ideal for a home office. In-unit laundry & storage closets, freshly painted walls, modern lighting fixtures & one-car independent garage parking w/ 2 deeded storage spaces. 170 Off Third exemplifies resort style living at its best! View roof deck, heated pool & outdoor spa overlooking lush landscaping, BBQ area, state of the art fitness center, private movie theater, club room w/ gourmet kitchen & professional management. Prime South Beach location is walking distance to world-class restaurants, shops/cafes & easy access to FiDi, Embarcadero, Ferry Bldg., Chase Center, Oracle, freeway,Bay Bridge, Muni,BART & CalTrain.
